summary:
Órbita Estelar is an educational video game about space exploration. In it, players can be commanders of a mission, design spaceships, choose instruments, explore planets, and do scientific activities.

The game has missions, challenges, and activities where players must analyze information and make decisions. It also has a main story and independent missions.

This project is important because it makes learning about astronomy, physics, and technology easier and more fun. It also helps develop creativity and reasoning skills.
details:
Órbita Estelar works through missions where players can create their own spaceships, explore planets, and do activities about space.

Its benefits are that players can learn about science and technology while having fun.

We want more people to become interested in space exploration and learn in a different way.

To create this project, we used programming and design tools to develop the video game.

It is creative because it combines a story, missions, challenges, and the option to design spaceships.

As a team, we made sure it was easy to use, fun, and educational.
